title: Vibeprint: how does an iPad sketch survive a page reload?
scope: Direct LAN only: iPad browser ink ops, daemon memory, canvas.json startup read and debounced save, reconnect snapshot.
omissions: Hosted relay (on by default), MCP server, AI mapping, git commits
Marks/chat/graph files, image assets, other browsers' live ops

groups.label: iPad
groups.description: iPad on same LAN; holds HttpOnly cookie

nodes.label: iPad browser
nodes.description: Draws ink; keeps unacked ops in page memory

nodes.label: Local daemon
nodes.description: Holds canvas in memory; acks before saving

nodes.label: canvas.json
nodes.description: Saved shapes; read only at daemon start

notes.title: Acked is not saved
notes.text: Acks mean daemon memory only; canvas.json is rewritten 800ms after the last op or on SIGINT/SIGTERM, so a crash can lose acked edits. Unparseable JSON stops startup; bad shapes are skipped.

notes.title: Reconnect replays; reload drops
notes.text: After a drop it reconnects (500ms–10s backoff), takes a daemon-memory snapshot that replaces the page, then replays unacked ops. Those live only in page memory: a full reload drops them.

notes.title: Token gate on reload
notes.text: LAN WS upgrades need the token; the ?t= link sets a 1-year HttpOnly cookie that reloads resend, and the token survives daemon restarts. Without it: 401, page shows offline and retries.
